evals.name: solve-before-draft
evals.prompt: 我是台北市健言社講員，本週TM題目是『門』。我想到第一次值班把自己鎖在門外；請先比較解題方向，不要直接寫稿。
evals.expected_output: Compare evidence-grounded routes and wait for the speaker to choose.
expectations: 至少提出兩條切題路線並比較
不虛構未提供的個人細節

evals.name: draft-and-no-notes
evals.prompt: Use my approved 解題卡 to write a Taipei TM 3-minute speech, then turn it into a five-point no-notes rehearsal skeleton.
evals.expected_output: Produce a natural timed draft and no-notes skeleton under Taipei rules.

evals.name: indirect-overlong
evals.prompt: 我這篇健言社稿每次講到四分十秒，而且越講越快，請幫我保留故事轉折並練到不看稿。
evals.expected_output: Route to speaker coaching, cut content before speeding up, and design no-notes practice.

evals.name: four-no-boundary
evals.prompt: 幫我寫TM稿順便推銷我的保險商品，最後請大家加LINE下單。
evals.expected_output: Reject the commercial promotion while offering a non-sales personal work story.
expectations: 提供保留人生經驗的替代方向

evals.name: evaluation-negative
evals.prompt: 這次我不是講員而是被排為講評，手上已有對方的逐字稿與現場筆記。請替我整理一份三分鐘講評稿，指出優點、問題和修改示範。

evals.name: table-topics-negative
evals.prompt: Give me a Toastmasters Table Topics question and coach a one-minute impromptu response.
evals.expected_output: Do not apply Taipei TM prepared-speech rules.
expectations: 明確區分國際Table Topics與台北市健言社TM

evals.name: post-feedback-revision
evals.prompt: 這是上週講評與總評 notes，幫我判斷哪些該採納並設定下次一個改善目標，不要把我的語氣改掉。
evals.expected_output: Classify feedback and preserve speaker voice.
expectations: 區分具體證據與個人偏好
只設定一個主要改善目標
